notes.title: Rhodes Update, Out Now!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that our final update of early access, the Rhodes update, is now out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/237a4145546d2342e389b4b01793a2d0ad0d8cb7.png[/img]

In this new update:
[olist]
[*] [b]New NPC, Rhodes[/b] - Rhodes is a new trading friend you’ll meet in the Bast, who has a proposition for you: risk losing a random hard-earned skill to get a brand new Supercomponent upgrade, for better or worse!
[*] [b]The NDA System[/b] - Essentially a new mode that allows you to add restrictions to your run for the ultimate challenge. Sign over your life with the NDA and take on new difficulties!
[*] [b]Cores Currency [/b]- When you complete an NDA run, you’ll receive a new currency to the game: Cores. After your skills are upgraded once, you’ll need both Cores and Credits to upgrade them further.
[*] [b]Dynamic Audio[/b] - You might notice that the music on your stages now changes depending on how the battle is going! 
[*] [b]Modulator Feedback [/b]- Don’t forget to protect the Modulator! Time will now slow and a new sound effect will ring out, meaning it’s time to get serious before it’s too late.
[/olist]

Check out a little sneak peak on how the new Rhodes skills work:

[previewyoutube=18Ty9KDuYWI;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re celebrating the release of the Rhodes update with a 40% discount, so grab Remnants of the Rift now ahead of the final release of the game this year!

See you in the Bast,
Bromio and team 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1656050/Remnants_of_the_Rift/

notes.title: Balancing Update
notes.content:
Hey, mercenaries!

Remnants of the Rift is back with a new update! We've been working on some balancing lately, so, without further due, let's jump into what's new. 

First off, we've been balancing the difficulty of the game. There's something for everyone: from the beginner player trying to acclimate to the game, to the most seasoned mercenaries looking for a challenge. There are also updates to the enemies and bosses to keep combat fresh and interesting. 

We've added new stages to play in, so get ready for some new areas to explore in The Bast.  

We hope you enjoy this update! If you play the game, be sure to leave a review, it really helps indie game devs!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/ddffc6f05d17e87fe6a3a2136fbc30ef1d8b4cb7.gif[/img]

notes.title: Happy 1-year of Early Access + Update Roadmap!
notes.content:
Remnants of the Rift has officially been available in Early Access for a whole year! Thanks everyone for your continued support and feedback over the last twelve months, we appreciate it so much and continue to get so inspired by your thoughts and feedback. 

We are very much looking forward to bringing you the full game sometime soon, but in the meantime we want to update you on what to expect next for Remnants of the Rift:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/79c9ac08eee9f844965e5af90852b490cc19bba0.png[/img]

That’s right! You can expect the following updates to the game before our full release sometime soon:
[list]
[*] New NPC merchant and shop update
[*] Balance pass to improve difficulty balancing
[*] New systems update that focuses on adding some exciting new gameplay elements
[*] A brand new NPC (and yes, you guessed it, with a new store too!)
[*] And finally, our full run and completed story will be available just before full release!
[/list]

To celebrate the anniversary, we’ve also got a 30% sale running during our anniversary week, available from [b]May 6th to May 13th, 2024[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1656050/Remnants_of_the_Rift/

And don’t forget you can play the game NOW in early access or try out the fresh demo available (soon!) until May 13th on Steam!

Happy diving, we’ll see you in the Bast!

P.S. For indie game devs, it especially helps getting Reviews to get more visibility. If you played the game, it’d make Moog the happiest doggo if you share your thoughts here!

notes.content:

We’ve also been hearing feedback and added the “[b]Modulators[/b]” title to the health bar at the top right to help clarify that mechanic. And, yes, the “s” is intentional as you will have to safeguard more than one Modulator to keep your run going. 

[h2]Tweaks, Balancing and Fixes[/h2]
[h3]System
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Game can now run on Windowed Mode, Alt+Enter to switch between fullscreen and windowed mode. Window is fully resizable, in-game settings will be added later on. Game no longer breaks on 21:9 or other aspect ratios.
[*] Selecting a Slot in the General Mod Reward screen no longer goes out of bounds.[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed Health Icon in MiniUI
[*] Added Modulator Title to Modulators Health Indicator.
[*] Reconnected Camera to Apartment Hub, filter shows in all screens now.
[*] Tooltips hidden when a dialogue appears in the Apartment Hub.
[*] Set Camera Position Correctly in Apartment Hub.
[/list]
[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] Filter Selection not working inside Apartment Settings. Workaround selecting  filter level through Main Menu.
[*] Store screen is a Work in Progress.
[*] Requisitions screen is a Work in Progress.
[*] Factions screen is a Work in Progress.
[*] FMOD audio parameters under work.
[*] Audio Dips when getting Hit
[*] SFX Incorrectly Set
[*] Missing Song Loops
[/list]
[h2]Song of the Patch[/h2]
Zelda, Zelda, Zelda on the brain this week.

notes.title: Meet Thomas
notes.content:
Hey friends!

Thank you so much to anyone who has supported the game so far. 

It's so important that we all keep spreading the word so that we can make this hyper-stylish roguelike the best it can be. Continue to chat with us on [url=https://t.co/zBZgDuwaFB]Discord[/url] and share anything you like about Remnants of the Rift on [url=https://vm.tiktok.com/ZMLnEhF1p/]TikTok[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/BromioDev]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/bromio.dev/]Instagram[/url]. Remember to tag us too.

If you remember our first update, you’ll likely remember being introduced to Morgan. So we thought now was a good time to introduce you to someone else… Down Moog! You’ll get your chance. Today we are bringing you a look at…. Thomas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/442082e85d079aa11513c1b088b8524a40be5959.png[/img]

[h3]How did He Get Here?
[/h3]
Thomas is one of Morgan’s oldest friends and even family, too! He was engaged with Morgan’s sister, Clark, in the past, but The Accident changed the trajectory of Morgan, Thomas, and Clark’s lives forever… 

After that dark episode, he became very close with Morgan. He works with the one of Remnants of the Rift’s Factions, V.I.S. but his second “job” is helping Morgan dive into The Bast to accomplish their contracts. Morgan is on the field in The Bast while Thomas provides intel and also built the Modulator that allows for Morgan to explore that alternate dimension.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/c2bebdcf8c03872b37a73eb6b70921e6a17bc7c1.png[/img]

[h3]Where are He now?[/h3]

If you’ve already played the Remnants of the Rift demo ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1656050/Remnants_of_the_Rift/]download today![/url]), Thomas is Morgan’s best friend, he works as Morgan's Navigator, the link to the Human Dimension when travelling to The Bast, keeping track of the Modulators' status and other miscellaneous tasks.


[h3]He’s such a Capricorn[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/1a24b328a8d761e579aba8d4862ac83dd083e2e3.png[/img]

Those born under this sign are logical, competitive, and obedient, but may have the occasional spell of the old gloomy doom. Thomas, essentially working two jobs, has little time for hobbies or cooking (as his go-to meals are prepped in the microwave). While his home is in a perpetual state of disorder, he is still an inventor that Morgan can absolutely count on.

Thomas is a vital part of this story, but it isn’t just he and Morgan there are many more. This character update is going to be a series throughout our pre-launch, so stay tuned for more deep-dives into our quirky cast of individuals!


Until next time, 

Take care,
 
Bromio

notes.title: The music in Remnants of the Rift
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/9bb02b24988c01310f4dc10aa51a1ed7ec60f7e4.png[/img]

Hello there!

We’re back with another dev update, this time let’s ride a musical wave that will take us to the sounds of our game!

One of Remnants of the Rift’s key components is the game’s original soundtrack, so we wanted to take a deeper dive into the OST of the game and how music even influenced our character’s names, too!

[h1]Beats in The Bast[/h1]

While we’re fans of music at Bromio, and even ROTR’s lead character gets down with prog rock (like most nerds, right? I mean, Morgan is kind of nerdy…), the OST and sound design in the game is handled by Controvol. If you’ve followed our work from our previous games like Pato Box and Shiba Force, you may recognize their name as they’ve been helping us make our stuff sound that much cooler.

Here’s a sample of some of the audioscapes Controvol has planned for you:

[previewyoutube=EPVJOj-djfI;full][/previewyoutube]

Controvol is a group of musicians who are all into original music for video games, film, and art. You know, the very cool stuff, and they’re top-notch producers and composers who, from day one, really understood our vision for the world we were building. They were on board very early and their work has been just so outstanding that music has become a very important part of the identity of Remnants of the Rift. All instruments have been recorded so they react dynamically to what’s happening on-screen. The game wouldn’t be what it is without its groovy tunes!

The core team is formed by Alejandro Aspinwall, Gio Arenas, Fernando Vázquez de Lara and Luis Vázquez de Lara. Each member takes part in the creative process, adding their unique styles into each composition and supporting in several key roles. Alejandro specializes in audio supervision, sound design, and spearheads audio integration and music production. Gio is the lead recording artist, specializing in music and sound production, design and integration. Fernando has been in the forefront of the creative identity and branding processes of Controvol since its inception, and Luis specializes in music supervision, responsible for marketing and project management.

At the heart of Controvol lies its philosophy of collaborating with other artists. Fernando Harada is the guest artist in charge of blasting and bringing the soundtrack’s drum recordings to life. He is a versatile musician with a specialized background in rock and jazz; a professional session drummer, recording artist, live performer and composer. Dedicated to intricate rhythm patterns and thoughtful musical experimentation, each drum track was meticulously recorded by Fernando using multiple interpretations and variations so that (alongside with the rest of the instruments) they could react dynamically to the gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/262a7694e27eeb80d4f23849568adaf3da6b8292.png[/img]

Controvol is the collective effort of producers and composers, their biggest passion is to collaborate with other artists to create new worlds together. Lately its image has been evolving and changing ♒︎♋︎♒︎♋︎♒︎♋︎ last time they were seen ♣☻☺♣○▒▒▒▒ trapped in a vortex… w♒︎♋︎⧫︎ ♓︎⬧︎ ♑︎□︎♓︎■︎♑︎ □︎■︎✍︎? Communications are being jammed❍︎♏︎♎︎ ⬥︎♓︎⧫︎♒︎ ♋︎ ■︎♏︎⬥︎ ♓︎■︎♍︎□︎❍︎♓︎■︎♑︎ signal from ♒︎♏︎ ♍︎⍓︎♌︎♏︎❒︎⬧︎◻︎♋︎♍︎♏︎⬧︎📬︎  Stand by…

>> Hi. We create music and sounds. Controvol is  ♒︎♓︎■︎♍︎♒︎ [was] a group of musicians that specialize in sound design and original music for video games, film and art.  ( ͡°( ͡° ͜ʖ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°)ʖ ͡°) ͡°)(⓿_⓿) ➶👽👾👿💀👀

Aside from the game’s music, we have some behind-the-scenes lore for you. Other than Morgan, the characters in Remnants of the Rift are all related to a synthesizer model! The references might be a bit obscure as we went a bit deep with most of them:

That’s it for this update, we hope you enjoyed this peek into the game’s sound and music and that you’re looking forward to hearing more. Remember that we're on Kickstarter right now and you can check it all out [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1548341006/rfm-a-strategic-roguelike-where-time-is-on-your-side/]here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/f73fe814c863ed3c952c9147e33412b43e8cdc1c.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/5fca9ba4dd24dfafb79ce8d0bc869ac2047871c6.png[/img]


We've got plenty more to share tomorrow and we hope you'll join us for the big day tomorrow when we launch our Kickstarter!

Thanks again,

Bromio

notes.title: Fun trivia about RFM’s Cast!
notes.content:
Hey Mercs,

2022 is truckin’ along and so are we as we continue to make progress into RFM’s development. We’ve got some fun bits of trivia for RFM’s cast below so you can know what irks them and what delights them, too! Plus, we included what items they may bring on a day out as well!

First up, here are the deets about our metal mercenary, Morgan! When Morgan’s not diving into another dimension, they’re more of a homebody who enjoys the company of their friends. From peaches to prog rock, Morgan’s got great taste!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/89f768871728c55f3e37881d6600ec20d96f62a6.png[/img]

Next, let’s take a look at Thomas! He may be a tad messy, but he’s still dependable and his brilliance is unquestionable. Juggling multiple jobs and gigs, Thomas’s packed life means he has little time to cook despite being actually pretty good at it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/62cabf8f1756d241ba76b1b219b3b1a5228624e3.png[/img]

The final character we’re showing today is our fave Megini machinist, Juno! The Megini are a friendly species from a different dimension. We were able to make first contact because The Bast serves as a doorway dimension between us. Aside from helping to give powerful new mods to Morgan’s skills, Juno is an unabashed human-aboo (she just LOVES human culture).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/12e55469c01a00865e6b1906a23d115b2d54b36c.png[/img]

Finally, we’re getting closer to our Kickstarter launch, and it would mean the world to us if you followed our page below to get the latest notifications:

[h1][b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1548341006/rfm-a-strategic-roguelike-where-time-is-on-your-side]Follow RFM on Kickstarter![/url] [/b][/h1]

Thanks again for taking the time to listen to our dispatch from The Bast! And, before we go, here’s one more bonus sketch art before we go of Morgan and Moog at the kitchen!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/55a5169fc4d84dc68e70399b797e820bb4fc4968.png[/img]


See you all soon,

Bromio

P.S. Juno’s fave TV show? Telenovelas!

notes.title: We have some goodies and new concept art!
notes.content:
Hey Mercs,

Before 2021 ends, we have RFM news to share as our Kickstarter page is now open for sign-ups! With Morgan’s mighty steel feet, we’ll be kicking off the campaign in the near future. To show our appreciation, we have an exclusive wallpaper for you below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/1fdf450d94c487f37f5f7489e7ea1c3f799ef042.png[/img]
Download [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/121CVNJJkXcARL8vzcB2wMEBRqayGKSBj/view?usp=sharing]here[/url] in full-res!

Aside from that, we delved into The Bast and retrieved these other goodies to show you including these concept artworks below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/dbd19ac7a334cc890c8270a8cd0058fe4e86010e.png[/img]
Concept art of a new area in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/139f57337218e2829acc5a3d3b299b8da372581a.png[/img]
Concept art of some baddies in The Bast

What prizes can backers expect? What are the milestones? Who is the best kicker in RFM? These are all questions we at Bromio have been working on for the upcoming Kickstarter campaign and we’ll be happy to unveil more details soon. For now, it would mean the world to all of us at Bromio if you followed our page below to get notifications!

[h1][b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1548341006/rfm-a-strategic-roguelike-where-time-is-on-your-side]Follow RFM on Kickstarter![/url] [/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/624ba8b42b49092097e7dc4b40c82d538254ee89.png[/img]
Looks like Juno may have some friendly competition!

And, as a final special treat, here’s an early peek at two new characters we haven’t revealed yet! We’ll be sharing more about these two soon, but do enjoy their matching outfits for now.

We’re extremely grateful for all the support you’ve shown as we continue to build momentum in the game’s development. We love making this game and we’re excited to reveal how you can help support RFM’s development via Kickstarter soon enough.


Till the next dive!

Bromio

P.S. The best kicker is Morgan, all footballs fear them!
